label: def:quark-antiquark-production
title: Quark--antiquark production from pair creation
html:
Definition. Quark--antiquark production from pair creation

Definition. A quark--antiquark production is the full chain \gamma\gamma \to q\bar{q}, in which two colored photons collide and their Hecke-algebra product reduces to a quark--antiquark channel. Each photon is the Hecke algebra element:

\gamma = \mathbf{1} + \varphi_0\sigma_0 + \varphi_1\sigma_1 + \varphi_{01}\sigma_0\sigma_1

with independent color weights \varphi_0, \varphi_1, \varphi_{01}.
